description: An algorithm is a set of instructions and rules that are used to solve an issue, process data, and complete other computing tasks. It is composed of a sequence of steps that when followed accurately, produces a desired output or goal. Algorithms are used in computers, mathematics, and other fields of study to provide reliable and repeatable solutions to complex problems.
